name: ghostagram
description: Codex workflows for compact MudBlazor forms and for running, editing, laying out, and exporting collaborative Ghostagram diagrams through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Build forms and edit live diagrams
interface.longDescription: Twelve focused skills scaffold and verify compact MudBlazor forms, run the local server, and support revision-safe human-and-agent Ghostagram collaboration.
defaultPrompt: Use $start-server to start or reuse the local Ghostagram collaboration server.
Use $stop-server to stop only the Ghostagram server process started by Codex.
Use $ghostagram-live-collaboration to discover capabilities, co-edit the Laboratory with a human, and verify its render acknowledgement.
Use $ghostagram-open-session to join an existing collaborative diagram.
Use $ghostagram-create-diagram to create and open a new diagram.
Use $ghostagram-sync-diagram to inspect or synchronize diagram state.
Use $ghostagram-apply-operations to make a revision-safe diagram change.
Use $ghostagram-layout-diagram to preview or commit deterministic layout.
Use $ghostagram-export-svg to export a revision-pinned SVG.
Use $ghostagram-close-session to close the current collaboration session.
Use $mudblazor-form-scaffold to create a compact typed form with reusable Blazor UI and server-owned feature behavior.
Use $mudblazor-form-verify to validate package resolution, builds, tests, visible form behavior, and the browser console.
